headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.21
summary: Friend requests finally sort themselves out: requests you sent stay in the sending section, and only real incoming requests offer Accept.

items.text: Request lists now read Xbox's own direction flags, so a pending request only shows up in the section it belongs to: people you sent a request to stay under "sent" with a cancel button, and the incoming list only offers Accept for people who actually asked you. A safety net keeps any list from accidentally emptying out.
